purpose: Security posture audit and threat model

critical_vulnerabilities.title: Default ADMIN role when X-User-Role header absent
critical_vulnerabilities.current_behavior: return Role.ADMIN  # Default to ADMIN in open internal demo environment
critical_vulnerabilities.impact: Complete authentication bypass, unauthorized data access and mutation
critical_vulnerabilities.remediation_required: Return 401 Unauthorized when X-User-Role is absent AND no authenticated principal exists

critical_vulnerabilities.title: Client-controlled role via X-User-Role header
critical_vulnerabilities.threat: Client can specify any role including ADMIN
critical_vulnerabilities.remediation_required: Derive role from server-authenticated JWT/session, never from client header

critical_vulnerabilities.title: Missing authentication on admin, ingest, and governance routes
critical_vulnerabilities.threat: Anonymous users can create accounts, upload data, modify graph
critical_vulnerabilities.impact: Data injection, account creation, system manipulation
critical_vulnerabilities.remediation_required: Add CurrentUser dependency to all sensitive routes

admin_only.current_security: VULNERABLE - NONE or X-User-Role header only
admin_only.required_security: JWT with ADMIN role from server
